ashmaw_death.speaker: narrator
ashmaw_death.text: Ashmaw lowers its head. The ford's fallen ember sliver gutters in the wall, then crumbles to grey dust. Nothing remains to sell or carry. A heavy claw rests warm against the stone.
ashmaw_death.currentMainText: Ashmaw lowers its head. The sliver of the ford's fallen ember in the wall gutters once, then crumbles into grey dust. Nothing remains to sell or carry. A heavy claw rests warm against the stone.

ch1_camp_warmth_1.speaker: narrator
ch1_camp_warmth_1.text: The thought returns with the smell of woodsmoke: the warmth was lent, not given. You look into the coals a little differently.

ch1_ford_pay_pass_2.speaker: bree_tallow
ch1_ford_pay_pass_2.text: He means the town chest, not my till. Still. Done.

ch1_ford_pay_fail_2.speaker: dagna_holt
ch1_ford_pay_fail_2.text: Twenty gold. My own. Now choose.

ch5_ritual_lead_wake_1.speaker: narrator
ch5_ritual_lead_wake_1.text: Around the flame, the dragon lies coiled with its eyes shut. Firelight moves beneath its scales, but it has not yet woken.

ashmaw_maud_waiting.speaker: old_maud
ashmaw_maud_waiting.text: I heard a fisher's boy is missing. I'll keep my fire ready if he finds his way here. As for that old bear... hunger wakes before a creature does. Go gently, if you can.

ashmaw_maud_after.speaker: old_maud
ashmaw_maud_after.text: The boy reached my fire, and I sent him home to his father. Poor old bear. A hundred winters, and the last was the coldest. Keep the claw; there is nothing else down there to carry home.

ashmaw_offer.speaker: dagna_holt
ashmaw_offer.text: A grey bear is taking goats from the pens, and a fisher's boy is missing. The cave mouth is below Maud's hut on the burned bank. Will you search for him and put an end to the bear?

ashmaw_done.speaker: dagna_holt
ashmaw_done.text: The pens are quiet, and the boy is home with his father. That is enough good news for one day.

bark_pip_ashdown_town_1.text: I can run that for you! One gold if you're nice. Two if you're not.

say_keep_gate_1.speaker: halvard
say_keep_gate_1.text: I had hoped you would turn back. I cannot yield the gate.

say_hall_of_the_flame_1.speaker: maren_sorrel
say_hall_of_the_flame_1.text: The circle is open. Bring your embers here and help me finish it!

say_hall_of_the_flame_2.speaker: maren_sorrel
say_hall_of_the_flame_2.text: The dragon came after the Fall for this heat. Now it wakes. Guard the hearth!

note: text is the proposed branch wording; ashmaw_death also includes current main wording because PR #301 fits it to the unchanged caption limit.
